description: This file defines an interface 'CompoundingPeriod' related to interest calculation in a savings domain, including method signatures for calculating interest and retrieving period intervals.

classes.name: CompoundingPeriod
classes.description: An interface that defines methods for computing interest for a savings account's compounding period, including interest calculation and period interval retrieval.

methods.name: calculateInterest
methods.description: Calculates interest based on provided interest period type, calculation type, previous interest, rate, days in year, and overdraft parameters.

methods.name: getPeriodInterval
methods.description: Returns the time interval representing the current interest period.
